answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 47445 Country: India Title: Zakat on gold Question: My question is, as I do not have cash to pay zakah of my wife jewellery so for next year, can we sell some portion of gold to come out from sahib-e-nisab. Answer ID: 47445 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1294/885/L=11/1434) The wife alone is responsible to pay the zakah of her jewelleries which is in her possession. If your wife sells some jewelleries and pays zakah with it and comes out of nisab then she may do so. Likewise she also may come out of nisab by selling some jewelleries for any other purpose. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
